info.name: Trickle API
info.description: Trickle API v1 (resource endpoints under /api/v1). Folders follow the golden path: employer invites worker, worker invites recipient. Set {{baseUrl}} to the deployed URL or http://localhost:4000.

request.description: Set {{privyAccessToken}} to the value of `await getAccessToken()` in the web app (or the `privy:token` entry in its localStorage). For the role tokens below, run `pnpm session employer|worker|family` in apps/api instead.
Answers 503 PRIVY_NOT_CONFIGURED when the server has no PRIVY_APP_ID.
409 COMPANY_EXISTS if this account already has a company (e.g. a second run).
Saves companyId for the requests below.

item.name: List company workers - not an employer (403)
Create recipient invite - not a worker yet (403)

request.description: Cancelling twice is fine. 409 INVITE_ALREADY_ACCEPTED once it was used.
Saves the first worker as workerId for the Workers folder.
Creates the account for this address if needed; it links when that wallet signs in with Privy. Re-running restores the worker after the delete below.
409 STREAM_ACTIVE when the employer still streams to this worker. The stream check is a placeholder until the indexer exists.
Saves the recipient from the family invite as recipientId.
Creates the account for this address if needed; it links when that wallet signs in with Privy. Re-running restores the recipient after the delete below.
409 SPLIT_ACTIVE while the worker's on-chain split (splitOf) still sends to this recipient.
Recipient only. The number is encrypted at rest; responses only carry accountNumberLast4. 503 BANK_ACCOUNTS_UNAVAILABLE without BANK_ENCRYPTION_KEY.

item.name: Add bank account - not a recipient (403)

request.description: 201 on the first call, 200 with alreadyDripped=true afterwards. 503 DRIP_UNAVAILABLE (no treasury key) or DRIP_TREASURY_EMPTY, 429 DRIP_IP_LIMIT / DRIP_DAILY_LIMIT. Old path POST /gas/drip still works (deprecated).

Real testnet stream from the demo employer to the signed-in account, no role needed. 201 the first time, 200 with alreadyStarted=true afterwards. 503 DEMO_UNAVAILABLE without DEMO_EMPLOYER_PRIVATE_KEY, 429 DEMO_IP_LIMIT / DEMO_DAILY_LIMIT.
Any signed-in account. The old public path GET /fx/usd-idr still works (deprecated).
